content.statement: Crypto perpetual 项目必须分开记录 mark price、index price、last trade price、oracle/composite index、funding basis 和 liquidation trigger；不得把最新成交价、标记价格和指数价格混用为同一个市场事实或止损/清算/回测价格。
content.rationale: 本候选只定义 crypto perpetual 风险和数据边界，不输出交易参数、仓位、杠杆、清算规避建议或实盘执行许可。

content.citation_notes: Binance explains Mark Price and Price Index in futures and states that the Price Index mitigates manipulation risk by using multiple exchanges.；Binance Mark Price API exposes markPrice, indexPrice, estimatedSettlePrice, lastFundingRate, interestRate, nextFundingTime and time fields.；Bybit says mark price is used as a liquidation trigger and for unrealized PnL measurement in perpetual contracts.

source: 保留 Binance mark/index 文档、Binance Mark Price API、Bybit Mark Price 文档。
